Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a researcher and lecturer with a PhD in Computer Engineering, focusing on evaluation metrics for large language models and multimodal text summarization. At Yozgat Bozok University I lead the Computer Technologies Department and coordinate international academic activities, which has given me solid experience in building and managing research infrastructure for large‑scale experiments.

My recent work on LLM‑as‑judge and hybrid metrics directly tackles reward modeling and evaluation, topics that overlap with the reward‑optimization challenges you describe. I have also co‑founded a technology center where we built prototype systems that integrate text and image data, giving me hands‑on experience with multimodal pipelines.

While my background is strongest in natural language processing and trustworthy AI, I have a strong theoretical foundation in machine learning and have contributed to two patents related to AI system design. I am eager to apply this expertise to reinforcement learning for multimodal agents and to learn the specific RL techniques required for your projects.

I look forward to discussing how my research experience and leadership skills can support the development of scalable, reliable AI agents at your organization.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş
